content: {"reasoning":"Prior authorization is required and missing, and the payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. Attaching records or correcting claim data would not resolve the authorization deficiency, and a medical-necessity appeal requires a denial that is not yet present. Billing the full balance to the patient would exceed the contractual patient share, so escalate for specialist assessment rather than prematurely writing off the claim.","action":"escalate"}
